status_summary: No Treasury action sending a federal financial statement to households was found. The Bureau of the Fiscal Service continues to publish the annual Financial Report of the U.S. Government; its FY2025 executive summary (page last updated 2026-05-07) reports a 1.8 trillion dollar deficit and 30.3 trillion dollars of federal debt and interest payable, without per-person or per-family figures. This existing report is not a statement delivered to each family.
